---
name: requirements-analysis
description: Use when requirements are incomplete, ambiguous, conflicting, or need to be separated from assumptions before planning.
---

# Requirements Analysis

Classify information as:

1. explicit requirement,
2. repository-confirmed fact,
3. material unresolved decision,
4. optional/non-blocking decision.

Do not promote framework defaults, industry conventions, or personal preference into requirements.

Ask for clarification only when the unresolved choice materially changes behavior, data, security, compatibility, architecture, or acceptance criteria. Otherwise record the assumption boundary and continue conservatively.
